$comment: Evidence rules dari Value Proposition Design (mapping §4).

evidence_rules.condition: The offer cannot be expressed in one complete sentence (who-problem-how-different from competitors).
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS an offer that cannot be stated in one complete sentence naming who it is for, which problem it solves, and how it differs from alternatives.

consequence.rationale: Ad-lib gagal terisi = capability belum berubah menjadi offer; disconnect terkonfirmasi.

evidence_rules.condition: pains/gains digambarkan tanpa threshold terukur (tidak ada angka menit/rupiah/persen dari ukuran customer)
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS customer pains or gains WITHOUT any measurable threshold (no minutes, rupiah, or percent from the customer's own measurement).

consequence.rationale: Severity cannot be validated; pain reliever cannot be designed precisely without a customer measure.

evidence_rules.condition: pain reliever / gain creator tidak memetakan ke job, pain, atau gain manapun di customer profile
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS a pain reliever or gain creator that does not map to any specific job, pain, or gain in a customer profile.

consequence.rationale: Fit check gagal: elemen itu kemungkinan tidak menciptakan customer value — jangan dihitung sebagai kekuatan offer.

evidence_rules.condition: customer profile is created with your own offer in mind (not in anthropologist mode)
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS building the customer profile from their own assumptions and offer, without observing actual customers (no customer interview, no research, no field contact).

consequence.rationale: Profile bias — jobs/pains/gains that are less relevant to the offer are not mapped; segment understanding becomes shallow.

evidence_rules.condition: offer is tested on customers BEFORE there is evidence that the targeted jobs/pains/gains actually matter
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS testing or pitching an offer to customers BEFORE establishing evidence that the targeted jobs, pains, or gains actually matter to them.

consequence.rationale: Rejection ambigu: menolak offer atau menolak pain yang tidak relevan? Verdict 'validated/invalidated' tidak sah — test-the-circle dulu.

evidence_rules.condition: revenue > costs is not yet proven (there is no evidence yet of a profitable and scalable business model)
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS that revenue exceeding costs has not been evidenced - margin, unit economics, or profitability unknown, never calculated, or untested.

consequence.rationale: Business model fit belum tercapai — product-market fit tidak boleh dinyatakan lengkap; great offer tetap bisa gagal.

evidence_rules.condition: A buyable unit exists: name, boundary of what is included, and a price attached to the capability.
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS turning a capability into a named, scoped, priced offer — a productized service a buyer could accept this week.

consequence.rationale: Offer terproduk (nama + scope + harga) adalah bukti langsung capability→offer terhubung — bukan lagi sekadar skill di kepala.
